Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

package dev.turboism.sdk.ui
Toolkit-neutral UI contracts for plugins.

Plugins declare semantic contributions, request user-mediated file access, and bind application actions through SDK identifiers. Turboism owns host adaptation, UI-thread dispatch, native widgets, contribution ordering, and cleanup; this package deliberately exposes no Swing, AWT, Cubism, native-handle, or raw host-object type.

A granted UI permission authorizes a request but does not make a provider family available. A runtime may retain a descriptor for diagnostics or future reconciliation, or fail closed when the corresponding host surface is unavailable. In-memory and fake-host behavior is not evidence of real Cubism host readiness. Contributions and handles are normally tied to the calling plugin's DisposableScope; close returned registrations early when the contribution is no longer wanted.
